title: psoralea mutisii
intro: Psoralea mutisii, commonly known as Peruvian clover, is a plant species native to South America. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to improve skin health, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea mutisii are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, cell damage, and autoimmune diseases. The bioactive constituents of Psoralea mutisii include isoflavones, coumarins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
